evidence.reason: Memory search hangs/corrupts metadata paths reported on 2026.6.8.
Heartbeat runner can leak private final replies to Telegram in message_tool_only mode.
Multi-agent/session write-lock and subagent delivery instability still reproduces through 2026.6.8.
Codex plugin-load boundary check aborts unrelated subagent runs on 2026.6.8.
Isolated cron agents can time out during long tool execution across 2026.6.5–2026.6.8.
Cron announce delivery can hit session takeover when a user is actively chatting; confirmed on 2026.6.8.
Foreground reply fence can cancel older in-flight replies after newer visible delivery.
Plugin-registered RPC methods return unknown method despite runtime registration on 2026.6.8.
plugins update --all can leave exact beta official plugins pinned after stable upgrade.
Azure OpenAI Responses probe/agent route can use OpenAI auth instead of Azure credentials.
memory_search ranks filename/date-token queries poorly despite clean index on 2026.6.8.

Telegram rich final reply can fail with RICH_MESSAGE_URL_INVALID for local Markdown hrefs.

Feishu bitable write tools emit invalid JSON Schema on 2026.6.8, blocking Bedrock/Anthropic tool use.
exec workdir values beginning with ~ fall back and can execute from the wrong directory on 2026.6.8.
memory_search cannot find the local embedding provider on 2026.6.8 even though CLI/status show it ready.
Externalized @openclaw/codex provider catalog fails to register on 2026.6.8 after upgrade from 2026.5.27.
@openclaw/copilot fails plugin registration on 2026.6.8 with openSyncKeyedStore undefined.
session-medic auto-heal can resume stale detached tasks into multi-session races/livelock on 2026.6.8.
Telegram richMessages regression still ships in v2026.6.8 stable while docs describe opt-in.
6.x state migration can leave channel conversation-store SQLite empty, breaking proactive sends after upgrade to 2026.6.8.
doctor cron-store finding persists after --fix on 2026.6.8 and references migrated jobs.json.
/reasoning on drops the thinking lane on Telegram for 2026.6.8 reasoning-model sessions.
Remote Ollama provider streaming can stall at model_call:started on 2026.6.8 while terminal requests complete.
Reasoning-model thinking payloads are not rendered on Discord with /reasoning on in 2026.6.8.
message(action=send) without target can fail for external plugin channels under message_tool_only on 2026.6.8.
skill_workshop apply can time out on large proposals over chat approval paths in 2026.6.8.
/v1/responses can fail to retain conversation context when using the same user value on 2026.6.8.
macOS Apple Silicon gateway crash-loops on 2026.6.8 with text-transforms runtime import failure.
Claude Code permission bridge returns deprecated allow shape; tool calls fail on 2026.6.8.
Codex OAuth/Appserver tiny turns regress to ~28s after prompt.submitted on 2026.6.8.
Darwin 25.x is mapped to the wrong macOS marketing version in 2026.6.8 status surface.
Cloud Control UI can remain stuck on protocol mismatch after 2026.6.8 update without user-friendly recovery.
OpenRouter short model IDs can be rewritten with a duplicated provider prefix on 2026.6.8.
Provider id rename after 2026.6.8 can orphan OAuth profiles without a clear migration warning.
Provider transport timeout is not classified as fallback-triggering timeout on 2026.6.8.
Anthropic claude-cli path sends stale user-agent on 2026.6.8 and can fail bearer auth.
Discord inbound media:// paths fail to resolve for image tool use on 2026.6.8.
Official openai/* model selection can auto-enable Codex plugin despite disabled/opt-out intent on 2026.6.8.
